memory_candidates.content: When editing a loader-owned JSON tracking file (e.g. .claude/extensions.json) in a repo with concurrent multi-task orchestration, isolate your addition first via `jq` on a snapshot to confirm it's purely additive, but be aware `git commit -- <pathspec>` re-stages from the working tree (not from a plumbing-staged index via update-index/hash-object), so any pre-existing unrelated uncommitted drift in the same file will be swept into your commit regardless of index isolation attempts. Verify the resulting commit is still benign (valid JSON, schema-correct, no unintended deployed-file clobber) rather than assuming isolation succeeded.
